post.summary: Validate an EU VAT number through VIES
post.description: Starter+. A single VAT check supporting the caller's intra-EU trade. Three enrichment units per successful response, including cached results and valid:false; errors consume no units. This is separate from Swedish SCB tax_status, syntactic organisation-number checks, and Stripe/Fortnox billing tax decisions. Name/address availability differs by country; null is not a mismatch. This endpoint does not perform approximate name matching. Results are cached for 24 hours per customer, VAT number and requester. Original check timestamps and consultation ID are preserved. Upstream outages, malformed upstream responses and timeouts never produce valid:false: retry according to Retry-After. Upstream timeout 10 seconds, no automatic retries.

200.description: Valid or invalid result, either newly checked or cached for up to 24 hours

400.description: Malformed body, unsupported country, query parameters, or VIES rejected input/requester details

403.description: Starter or higher required, or key restricted

429.description: Customer attempt limit or normal API quota/rate limit exceeded; no definitive VAT status

503.description: VIES unavailable, timeout, capacity limit or circuit breaker; valid is null

get.description: Pro+. Uses 3 enrichment units. Daily local GLEIF Golden Copy snapshot; no upstream lookup. Linkage uses a validated Swedish organisation number registered with Bolagsverket (RA000544), never a name match. Current ACTIVE/PUBLISHED direct and ultimate accounting-consolidating relationships are separate from legal ownership; no ownership percentage is inferred. Other relationship states, including LAPSED, are retained in other_relationships. Relations and exceptions refer to canonical_lei only. All matched identities are retained; competing identities return ambiguous and no canonical parents. An empty parent list does not establish that a company has no parent; reporting_exceptions preserves source reasons. Foreign parents may have no Swedish orgnr. Source record dates are independent of snapshot publication; stale means publication older than 48 hours. The same object is included as international_relationships on /group, independently of its Swedish structure.

post.summary: Get companies connected to a person (Pro+)
post.description: Returns companies where the person is connected through registered roles such as board member, CEO, signatory, auditor, or other company engagement. A supplied personnummer starts a demand-driven background identity resolution when local data is missing; poll responses returned with HTTP 202 according to Retry-After. No bulk identity resolution is performed for company boards. Supply a person_id from the company persons endpoint when no personnummer is available. This endpoint is for general company engagements, not official beneficial ownership.

Search companies by text query and/or filters. Text search is optional - filter-only searches are supported. Multi-value filters accept comma-separated values (OR logic within filter, AND logic between filters).

parameters.description: Search query (min 3 characters if provided). Optional - filter-only searches are supported.

parameters.name: sni
parameters.description: Filter by SNI code(s), comma-separated. Prefix-matches against **all** of a company's registered SNI codes (up to 5 per company, both primary and secondary) — e.g. `sni=46340` returns companies where 46340 appears in any SNI slot. Shorter prefixes broaden the match: `sni=62` matches 62010, 62020, …. Multiple codes are OR'd together (max 10).

get.description: Get a list of annual reports for a company with pagination support. Check downloadable before offering a report-file download.

Download a specific annual report when downloadable=true. PDF is the default. The API authorizes the request and usually returns a 302 redirect to a short-lived signed download URL. Use ?format=raw for the original iXBRL file when available. For customers with the BRF module, BRF PDFs return 200 application/pdf directly and use the module PDF allowance: 500 unique association/fiscal-period downloads included per module period, then graduated pricing. Repeat downloads do not count again.

get.description: Get registered workplace locations for a legal entity. The organization number identifies the legal entity, while the CFAR number from SCB's Centrala företags- och arbetsställeregistret identifies an individual workplace. Several workplaces can share one organization number. A workplace is not necessarily a legal branch or separate legal entity. Coverage depends on source data. Returns an empty array if no workplace data is available.

post.description: Export company, contact and latest financial data with a Business API key (personal or team). Preview returns an exact count and up to 100 sample rows without consuming export rows. A full export returns one row per organisation, up to 100000 rows and 64 MiB, from one consistent snapshot. Business includes 1000000 export rows per UTC calendar month shared by the payer; no base API units or additional monetary charge. Preview and execution are separate snapshots.
